## Editorial and evidence standards
- Independent practitioner analysis; no sponsorship or affiliate content.
- Articles identify the author, publication date, sources, and limitations. Vendor and regulatory details should be checked against cited primary sources because they can change.
- Content is licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribution and a link to the canonical article are appreciated.
